title: Real-Life: Pharmacy pickup
situation: You had a prescription filled at a hospital pharmacy yesterday, but you have not picked it up yet. You call the pharmacy and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for calling Riverside Hospital Pharmacy.
Narrator: Your prescription is ready, but it has not been picked up yet.
Narrator: Please come to the pharmacy window on the first floor before six p.m. today.
Narrator: After six, the medicine will be returned to the storage room, and you will need a new prescription from your doctor.
Narrator: Our hours are eight thirty a.m. to six p.m., Monday through Saturday.
Narrator: When you come, please bring your identification card, because we cannot release medicine without it.
Narrator: To speak with a pharmacist, please press one.
translation:
リバーサイド病院薬局にお電話いただきありがとうございます。
お薬の準備はできていますが、まだお受け取りいただいていません。
本日午後6時までに、1階の薬局の窓口へお越しください。
6時を過ぎますと、お薬は保管室に戻され、医師から新しい処方箋をいただく必要があります。
営業時間は月曜から土曜まで、午前8時30分から午後6時までです。
お越しの際は身分証明書をお持ちください。確認できないとお薬はお渡しできません。
薬剤師と話すには、1を押してください。

questions.question: How should you get your medicine today?
choices: Ask your insurance company to change the medicine.
Visit the hospital's emergency room for a checkup.
Mail your identification card to the hospital.
Collect your medicine at the first-floor pharmacy window.
questions.explanation: 「Please come to the pharmacy window on the first floor before six p.m. today.」より、今日の午後6時までに1階の薬局の窓口で薬を受け取る。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: School trip form
situation: You are the parent of a second-grade student at Maple Elementary School. You hear the following recorded message from the school.
script:
Narrator: Good afternoon. This is Maple Elementary School with a message for parents.
Narrator: Next Tuesday, the second grade will visit the city aquarium for a science trip. Students will leave school at nine a.m. and return by two thirty p.m.
Narrator: The permission form was sent home last Friday, but many families have not returned it yet. Without a signed form, your child cannot join the trip.
Narrator: Signed forms must be returned to the school office by Monday afternoon.
Narrator: Students who do not join the trip will study in the library with another teacher.
Narrator: If you have lost the form, you can download a new copy from the school website.
translation:
こんにちは。保護者の皆様へのお知らせです。メープル小学校からお伝えします。
来週の火曜日、2年生は科学の授業の一環で市の水族館を訪問します。児童は午前9時に学校を出発し、午後2時30分までに戻る予定です。
許可書は先週の金曜日に家庭へ配りましたが、まだ提出されていないご家庭も多くあります。署名入りの許可書がないと、お子さんは遠足に参加できません。
署名入りの許可書は、月曜日の午後までに学校の事務室へ提出してください。
遠足に参加しない児童は、別の先生と図書室で勉強します。
許可書をなくされた場合は、学校のウェブサイトから新しい用紙をダウンロードできます。

questions.question: Which step is needed for your child to join the trip?
choices: Tell the teacher at the aquarium on Tuesday morning.
Hand in the signed permission form by Monday afternoon.
Pay the trip fee at the school office on Friday.
Ask the library teacher to watch your child.
questions.explanation: 「Without a signed form, your child cannot join the trip.」「Signed forms must be returned to the school office by Monday afternoon.」より、署名入りの許可書を月曜の午後までに学校の事務室へ出す。ほかの選択肢は、本文に費用の話がない、または時期や場所が合わない。

title: Real-Life: Bus route detour
situation: You live on Oak Street and usually take the number 12 bus to work on weekdays. You call the bus company and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for calling Metro City Bus Information.
Narrator: Because of bridge repairs on Harbor Road, the number 12 bus will not cross the river until the end of March.
Narrator: During this time, the bus will end its route at Central Station, and the stop on Oak Street will be closed.
Narrator: Passengers who normally board at Oak Street can use the number nine route instead. This bus stops on Elm Avenue, about two blocks east of the closed stop.
Narrator: The number nine runs every thirty minutes during the repairs, so please check the timetable on our website before you leave home.
Narrator: We apologize for any inconvenience.
translation:
メトロシティ・バス案内にお電話いただきありがとうございます。
ハーバー通りの橋の補修工事のため、12番のバスは3月末まで川を渡りません。
この期間、バスはセントラル駅で運行を終え、オーク通りの停留所は閉鎖されます。
ふだんオーク通りから乗られるお客様は、代わりに9番の路線をご利用いただけます。このバスはエルム通りに止まり、閉鎖された停留所から2区画ほど東にあります。
工事中、9番は30分おきに運行しています。お出かけの前に、ウェブサイトで時刻表をご確認ください。
ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。

questions.question: How can you get to work during the repairs?
choices: Walk two blocks east to Elm Avenue and board the number nine bus.
Wait at Oak Street for the number 12 bus.
Take a taxi across the bridge on Harbor Road.
Call the bus company to request a new route.
questions.explanation: 「This bus stops on Elm Avenue, about two blocks east of the closed stop.」より、オーク通りから2区画東のエルム通りまで歩き、9番のバスに乗る。12番は工事中は橋を渡らず、オーク通りの停留所も閉鎖されている。

title: Real-Life: Warning light
situation: Tonight the red oil warning light came on while you were driving your car. You need the car for a job interview tomorrow morning. You call Eastside Auto Service and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Thank you for calling Eastside Auto Service.
Narrator: Our service center is closed on Sundays, but our emergency line is open twenty-four hours a day.
Narrator: If the red oil pressure light is on, stop the engine right away and do not drive, even for a short distance.
Narrator: Our roadside team can tow your vehicle to our center free of charge, but only if you call the emergency line first.
Narrator: If only the yellow engine light is on, you may drive to the service center, but please book an appointment online first.
Narrator: Tomorrow's appointments are full, so the earliest available booking is on Monday morning.
Narrator: Walk-in customers are welcome on weekdays, although waiting times can be long.
Narrator: Please note that the free tow service does not apply to walk-in visits.
translation:
イーストサイド自動車サービスにお電話いただきありがとうございます。
サービスセンターは日曜休業ですが、緊急用の電話番号は24時間つながります。
赤いオイル圧力の警告灯が点いている場合は、すぐにエンジンを止め、短い距離でも運転しないでください。
当社のロードサービスがお車をセンターまで無料でけん引しますが、先に緊急用の電話番号へご連絡いただいた場合に限ります。
黄色のエンジン警告灯だけが点いている場合は、サービスセンターへ運転していただけますが、先にインターネットで予約をお願いします。
明日の予約は埋まっており、いちばん早く取れるのは月曜の午前です。
平日は予約なしでのご来店も歓迎ですが、待ち時間が長くなることがあります。
予約なしでご来店の場合、無料のけん引サービスは対象外ですのでご注意ください。

questions.question: What should you do tonight?
choices: Pull over, switch off the engine, and phone the 24-hour line for a free pickup.
Drive to the service center and wait for a walk-in check.
Book an appointment online for Monday morning.
Keep driving carefully until you reach home.
questions.explanation: 「If the red oil pressure light is on, stop the engine right away and do not drive」と「only if you call the emergency line first」をつなぐ。赤い警告灯なので運転せず、先に緊急用の電話にかけて無料のけん引を頼む。月曜の予約は黄色い警告灯の場合の手順なので、今夜の対応としては誤り。

title: Real-Life: Pottery workshop change
situation: You signed up for a pottery workshop at Hillside Community Center. You hear the following message on the phone, and you are not sure when and where the workshop is now.
script:
Narrator: Hello, this is Hillside Community Center calling about Saturday's pottery workshop.
Narrator: Our first notice said the workshop would be held in Room 3 on Thursday evening. Please disregard that information.
Narrator: Room 3 has a water leak, so we moved the workshop to Room 7 on Friday evening. Unfortunately, the kiln in Room 7 is now being repaired, so Friday is no longer possible.
Narrator: The workshop will take place on Saturday morning in the ground-floor studio, which has a working kiln.
Narrator: Please do not go to Room 3 or Room 7 this week, because both rooms will be closed.
Narrator: Participants should bring their own apron and towel, because the studio does not supply them.
Narrator: Aprons can also be bought at the front desk, but supplies are limited.
Narrator: If you cannot attend the Saturday session, please call us before Friday noon to cancel your place.
translation:
こんにちは。ヒルサイド・コミュニティセンターの陶芸教室についてのお電話です。
最初のお知らせでは、陶芸教室は木曜の夕方に3号室で行うとしていました。その情報は無視してください。
3号室で水漏れがあったため、陶芸教室は金曜の夕方に7号室へ移しました。ただ、7号室の窯が修理中のため、金曜はできなくなりました。
陶芸教室は土曜の午前、1階のスタジオで行います。このスタジオの窯は使えます。
今週は3号室にも7号室にも行かないでください。どちらの部屋も閉鎖されます。
参加者は、スタジオでは用意していないため、エプロンとタオルを各自ご持参ください。
エプロンは受付でも買えますが、数が限られています。
土曜の回に出席できない場合は、金曜の正午までにお電話でお申し込みをキャンセルしてください。

questions.question: When and where should you go to attend the workshop?
choices: Go to Room 3 on Thursday evening.
Head to the ground-floor studio on Saturday morning.
Go to Room 7 on Friday evening with your own apron.
Go to the ground-floor studio on Saturday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「The workshop will take place on Saturday morning in the ground-floor studio」。木曜の3号室は水漏れで、金曜の7号室は窯の修理で使えないと訂正されている。土曜の午後は誤りで、場所は同じ1階のスタジオでも時間が違う。

title: Real-Life: Planned power outage
situation: You live in an apartment in Northern City. You receive the following recorded message from the electric company.
script:
Narrator: This is a message from Northern Electric about a planned power outage.
Narrator: On Sunday, the power in your area will be turned off from eight a.m. until noon, so that workers can repair the main line.
Narrator: Please charge your phones and other devices before Sunday morning, because there will be no electricity during this time.
Narrator: Refrigerators can stay closed, and they will keep food cold for several hours.
Narrator: If you use medical equipment at home, please contact our customer center this week.
translation:
これはノーザン電力からの、計画停電のお知らせです。
日曜日、作業員が本線の修理を行うため、お住まいの地域の電気は午前8時から正午まで止まります。
この時間は電気が使えなくなりますので、日曜の朝までにスマートフォンなどの機器を充電しておいてください。
冷蔵庫は閉めたままで構いません。食品は数時間は冷たいまま保たれます。
自宅で医療機器を使っている方は、今週中にお客様センターまでご連絡ください。

questions.question: Which task should you finish before Sunday morning?
choices: Fully charge your phones and other devices.
Move your bicycle to the garage on Saturday.
Contact the city council about the road repairs.
Send a payment to the power company by Friday.
questions.explanation: 「Please charge your phones and other devices before Sunday morning」より、日曜の朝までにスマートフォンなどを充電しておく。ほかの選択肢は本文に出てこない内容。

title: Real-Life: Dog vaccination reminder
situation: You have a dog named Max, and its rabies vaccination is due this month. You call the animal clinic and hear the following recorded message.
script:
Narrator: Hello, you have reached Greenfield Animal Clinic.
Narrator: This is a reminder that your dog's rabies vaccination is due by the end of this month.
Narrator: Our doctors are available for vaccinations on weekdays between nine a.m. and five p.m. We are closed on Saturday afternoons.
Narrator: Walk-in vaccinations are not available this month because of a staff shortage, so please call us to book a time.
Narrator: When you visit, bring your dog's registration card and vaccination record.
Narrator: Please note that our phone line is busiest on Monday mornings, so calling early in the week is helpful.
Narrator: If your dog has already been vaccinated at another clinic, please email us a copy of the certificate.
translation:
こんにちは。グリーンフィールド動物病院です。
お住まいの犬の狂犬病ワクチンの期限は、今月末までです。そのお知らせです。
獣医師によるワクチン接種は、平日の午前9時から午後5時までです。土曜の午後は休診です。
スタッフ不足のため、今月は予約なしでのワクチン接種はできません。お電話で時間の予約をお願いします。
ご来院の際は、犬の登録証とワクチン接種記録をお持ちください。
月曜の朝はお電話が混み合いますので、週の早いうちにお電話いただくと助かります。
ほかの病院で接種済みの場合は、証明書の写しをメールでお送りください。

questions.question: How can you keep your dog's vaccination on schedule?
choices: Walk your dog into the clinic on Saturday afternoon.
Email the vaccination record to the city council.
Phone the clinic to schedule a time before the month is over.
Give your dog the vaccination at home this weekend.
questions.explanation: 「your dog's rabies vaccination is due by the end of this month」「please call us to book a time」より、今月末までに電話で予約を取る。土曜の午後は休診で、予約なしの接種もできない。

title: Real-Life: Wrong bookshelf delivered
situation: You ordered a tall bookshelf from Oakwood Furniture, but the one delivered yesterday is the standard size and does not fit your room. You call the store and hear the following conversation with the clerk.
script:
Woman: Thank you for calling Oakwood Furniture. How can I help you?
Man: The bookshelf I ordered was delivered yesterday, but it is the standard size. I ordered the tall model, and it does not fit in my room.
Woman: I'm sorry about that. The tall model is in stock at our downtown branch, so we can exchange it.
Man: That's good. Can someone collect the wrong shelf from my home?
Woman: Our truck only collects on Thursdays. Collecting on another day costs extra, but the downtown branch can exchange it at no charge if the old shelf is brought in by Friday.
Man: I'm working on Thursday, so I won't be home.
Woman: Then please bring the receipt with the shelf, or the exchange will not be accepted.
translation:
女性:オークウッド家具にお電話いただきありがとうございます。ご用件をお伺いします。
男性:注文した本棚が昨日届いたのですが、標準サイズでした。私は背の高いタイプを頼んだので、部屋に入りません。
女性:申し訳ございません。背の高いタイプはダウンタウン店に在庫がございますので、交換できます。
男性:それはよかった。間違った棚を自宅から引き取りに来てもらえますか。
女性:トラックによる引き取りは木曜日だけです。ほかの日に引き取る場合は追加料金がかかります。ただ、ダウンタウン店では、古い棚を金曜までに持ち込んでいただければ、無料で交換できます。
男性:木曜は仕事なので、家にいられません。
女性:では、棚と一緒にレシートもお持ちください。でないと交換をお受けできません。

questions.question: What should the man do to get the tall model at no charge?
choices: Stay home on Thursday and wait for the truck.
Pay the extra fee for a collection on another day.
Take the old shelf and the receipt to the downtown branch by Friday.
Ask the store to refund the full price of the bookshelf.
questions.explanation: 「the downtown branch can exchange it at no charge if the old shelf is brought in by Friday」「please bring the receipt with the shelf」より、金曜までに古い棚とレシートを持ち込む。男性は木曜に仕事で家にいられないので、無料の木曜の引き取りは使えない。

title: Real-Life: Essay submission during maintenance
situation: You are a university student. Your essay is due on Sunday, and it is now Saturday night. The file is large, and you have not finished it. You hear the following message from the university's IT department.
script:
Narrator: This is the IT Services Department of Crestview University with an important notice.
Narrator: The student portal will be closed for system maintenance this Sunday from six a.m. until six p.m.
Narrator: Assignments due on Sunday cannot be submitted through the portal during this time. Instead, professors will accept them by email until midnight.
Narrator: However, the email system does not accept attachments larger than five megabytes, so please compress large files before you send them.
Narrator: Students who cannot finish by Sunday midnight may request a one-day extension through the portal, but only before Saturday evening.
Narrator: Requests sent after Saturday evening will not be approved.
Narrator: The help desk will be open on Saturday until eight p.m. if you have questions about the file size.
Narrator: We apologize for any inconvenience.
translation:
こちらはクレストビュー大学情報サービス部からの重要なお知らせです。
この日曜日は、システムの保守のため、午前6時から午後6時まで学生ポータルを停止します。
この時間は、日曜締切の課題をポータルから提出できません。代わりに、教員は深夜0時までメールでの提出を受け付けます。
ただし、メールは5メガバイトを超える添付ファイルを受け付けません。大きなファイルは送る前に圧縮してください。
日曜の深夜0時までに終わらない学生は、ポータルから1日の延長を申請できます。ただし、申請は土曜の夕方までに限ります。
土曜の夕方以降に送られた申請は承認されません。
ファイルの大きさについてのご質問は、土曜日の午後8時まで相談窓口がお受けします。
ご不便をおかけして申し訳ありません。

questions.question: How should you submit your essay on time?
choices: Submit the essay through the student portal on Sunday morning.
Request a one-day extension through the portal right now.
Upload the essay to the library's cloud drive on Monday morning.
Shrink the file below the size limit and email it to your professor by midnight.
questions.explanation: 「professors will accept them by email until midnight」と「please compress large files before you send them」をつなぐ。土曜の夜なので延長は申請できず、日曜の午前はポータルが停止している。大きいファイルは圧縮してメールで提出する。

title: Real-Life: Boat tour departure change
situation: You booked a boat tour for this Saturday afternoon. You hear the following message from the tour company on your voicemail.
script:
Narrator: Hello, this is Bayview Boat Tours with an update about your Saturday afternoon trip.
Narrator: Our first notice said that boats would leave from Pier 2 at one p.m. Please disregard that information.
Narrator: Pier 2 is closed for repairs until next month, so we moved the departure point to Pier 5. However, the harbor master has since asked us to avoid Pier 5 because of heavy construction there this week.
Narrator: The final departure point is the small marina next to the lighthouse, and boats will leave at one thirty p.m. Please do not go to Pier 5 at any time this week.
Narrator: The lighthouse marina has only a small parking lot, and it fills up early, so we suggest taking the bus from the train station instead.
Narrator: Because the boat is smaller this week, please bring only one small bag per person.
Narrator: If you need to change your booking, please call us before Friday evening. After that, changes are not possible.
translation:
こんにちは。ベイビュー・ボートツアーです。今週土曜の午後のツアーについてお知らせします。
最初のお知らせでは、船は午後1時に2番埠頭から出発するとしていました。その情報は無視してください。
2番埠頭は来月まで修理のため閉鎖されているため、出発地点を5番埠頭に変更しました。ただ、港湾管理者から、今週そこで大規模な工事があるため、5番埠頭は避けるよう求められました。
最終的な出発地点は、灯台の隣にある小さなマリーナです。船は午後1時30分に出ます。今週は5番埠頭には、いつも行かないでください。
灯台のマリーナは駐車場が小さく、早く満車になるため、代わりに駅からバスをご利用ください。
今週は船が小さくなるため、お一人につき小さなバッグを1つだけお持ちください。
予約の変更が必要な場合は、金曜の夕方までにお電話ください。その後は変更できません。

questions.question: Where should you go to join the boat tour on Saturday?
choices: Go to Pier 2 at one p.m. for the first boat.
Head to the small marina beside the lighthouse for the one-thirty departure.
Go to Pier 5 and then take the bus from the train station.
Wait at the train station for a boat to pick you up.
questions.explanation: 最後の案内は「The final departure point is the small marina next to the lighthouse, and boats will leave at one thirty p.m.」。2番埠頭は修理、5番埠頭は工事で使えないと訂正されている。駅のバスは駐車場が混むときの移動手段で、駅で船を待つのは誤り。
